title: Sad Hamster
blurb: Mournful violin, wide wet eyes, and a small creature staring directly into your conscience. The Sad Hamster became the internet's mascot for being little, pitiful and dramatically wronged by circumstances entirely outside its control. Use it when an order arrives incorrect, when a meeting could clearly have been an email, when it begins raining precisely as you step outside without a coat. Peak cuteness deployed as peak melodrama, which is a combination that consistently outperforms either element used on its own.
origin: The viral wide-eyed hamster meme with sad violin backing (from the 'Hampter' family of memes).
